name: LANDRY, the Hon. Michelle Leanne

headline.note: The official parliamentary biography supplies year-level intervals for laboratory work, National Australia Bank supervision, family-business bookkeeping/property management, small-business ownership and political staffing. It does not identify the laboratory employer, family/business entities, full-time status, leave or precise transitions. Several roles overlap between 1999 and 2012. Political staffing, party work and elected office are excluded. No full-time public/private total is defensible; missing evidence is not zero.

career_spells.employer: Pathology and medical biochemistry laboratory employer not identified
career_spells.evidence_note: The official parliamentary biography gives the occupation and 1978–1985 interval. A Rockhampton Girls Grammar alumni publication independently repeats it. Employer, laboratory setting, public/private control, exact boundaries, hours and leave are not published; the start year overlaps Landry's final school year in the alumni record.
career_spells.counting_note: Employer control and substantive full-time status are unresolved.

career_spells.evidence_note: Official parliamentary records give the employer, supervisor title and 1985–2007 interval. They do not publish exact appointment/cessation dates, hours, leave or changes in role. From 1999 the interval overlaps family construction-business work.
career_spells.counting_note: A senior title and long tenure do not by themselves prove continuous full-time service.

career_spells.employer: Family construction business (legal entity not identified)
career_spells.evidence_note: The official biography describes bookkeeping and property management in a family construction business from 1999 to 2009. The legal entity, payroll/self-employment status, hours and leave are not supplied. The spell overlaps NAB supervision through 2007 and the separately listed small business from 2007.
career_spells.counting_note: Overlapping year-level work without hours or entity evidence cannot be converted into a full-time duration.

career_spells.employer: Small business (name and legal entity not identified)
career_spells.role: Owner/operator; bookkeeping services reported by member biography
career_spells.evidence_note: The official parliamentary biography lists small-business ownership from 2007 to 2013. Landry's official site says she ran her own bookkeeping business immediately before winning Capricornia. The business entity, clients, hours, operational continuity, leave and election transition are unpublished; this interval overlaps family-business work, political staffing and party office.
career_spells.counting_note: Self-employment may count when substantive full-time boundaries are supported; they are not here.

career_spells.evidence_note: Official parliamentary records list electorate-officer work from 2010 to 2012. The member or office, payroll employing authority, exact dates, hours, leave and overlap with candidacy and business ownership are not identified.
career_spells.counting_note: Political staff employment is excluded irrespective of public funding.

career_spells.employer: Liberal National Party Capricornia Federal Electorate Council
career_spells.evidence_note: The official biography records the party position from 2009 to 2013. It does not state whether the role was paid, its hours or exact dates.
Official parliamentary service begins with the 7 September 2013 federal election.

research_notes: Identify the pathology/medical-biochemistry laboratory employer, dates, hours and ownership/control; reconcile the 1978 start with the final school year.
Obtain NAB role progression, exact dates, hours and leave and reconcile the 1999–2007 overlap with family-business bookkeeping/property management.
Identify the family construction business and separate small bookkeeping business legal entities, payroll/self-employment status, hours, clients, cessation and all overlaps.
Identify the 2010–2012 electorate office and employing authority; obtain exact appointment, cessation, hours, leave and campaign arrangements.
Follow up the Lucky Daniels casket-agency childhood/first-job reference and include it as employment only if dates, paid status and substantive work can be established.
